# 🤖 test-automation

Unit tests, TDD, Playwright, mocking, visual regression, migration and test code review.

Install: `test-automation@jaktestowac`. See the [quick start](https://github.com/jaktestowac/awesome-agents-for-quality#-quick-start) for each tool.

## Commands

Run these yourself: `/name` in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, `$name` in Codex. The agent never starts them on its own.

- [`fix-tests`](skills/fix-tests/SKILL.md): Fix failing tests
- [`explain-test-failure`](skills/explain-test-failure/SKILL.md): Explain a test failure
- [`analyze-test-results`](skills/analyze-test-results/SKILL.md): Analyze test results
- [`stabilize-flaky-tests`](skills/stabilize-flaky-tests/SKILL.md): Stabilize flaky tests
- [`test-generator`](skills/test-generator/SKILL.md): Generate tests based on test plan
- [`playwright-generate-test`](skills/playwright-generate-test/SKILL.md): Generate tests based on a scenario using Playwright MCP
- [`playwright-explore-website`](skills/playwright-explore-website/SKILL.md): Explore a website and propose test cases
- [`playwright-explore-website-requests`](skills/playwright-explore-website-requests/SKILL.md): Explore a website and gather network requests using Playwright MCP
- [`refactor-to-page-objects`](skills/refactor-to-page-objects/SKILL.md): Refactor tests to page objects
- [`migrate-tests-to-playwright`](skills/migrate-tests-to-playwright/SKILL.md): Migrate tests to Playwright
- [`tech-debt-audit`](skills/tech-debt-audit/SKILL.md): Tech debt audit - test automation code review

Claude Code and GitHub Copilot load these agents with the plugin.
Codex does not load agents from plugins: copy the files from [`codex/agents/`](codex/agents/) into your project's `.codex/agents/` or into `~/.codex/agents/`.

## MCP servers

- `playwright`: `npx @playwright/mcp@latest`

Claude Code and Codex start these from the plugin. In GitHub Copilot, add them to your MCP configuration yourself.
